intent: Swiss conference hero on a black poster (theme prop for white paper): drawn 12-column guides, giant lowercase headline, one accent quarter circle, numbered index.

layout.grid: 4 cols gap 16px; 12 cols gap 24px from @3xl; guides rendered on the same grid
rows: index nav: No. | Track (5) | Speaker (3) | When (3)

color.tokens: one PALETTE object written to CSS variables (--sg-bg, --sg-ink, --sg-on-ink, --sg-accent)
color.accent: #e10600 via the accent prop: quarter circle, hover underline/arrow/number, button hover fill, focus rings only

motion.containers: 12 guides scaleY 0→1 from top + fade, 700ms, 20ms apart; meta rule scaleX 0→1 from left
motion.text: meta cells then headline lines rise 12px from blur(8px), 600ms, 60–72ms apart
motion.figure: quarter circle scale 0→1 from its top-right corner, 700ms at 0.38s, no rotation
motion.introRow: intro, actions, notes rise from blur at 0.44s, 60ms apart
motion.index: header rule draws, labels fade up, rows rise from blur 60ms apart while each hairline draws from the left
motion.hover: accent underline grows 0→100% (400ms); arrow slides in; button fills with accent
motion.reducedMotion: one 150ms opacity fade for everything; no transforms, blur or stagger
motion.press: buttons and links 0.97, rows 0.99, 150ms; one shared transition for colour and transform

responsive.narrow: 4-col grid, quarter circle above the headline (cols 3-4), headline 19cqi, index rows stack speaker/time

accessibility: nav + ordered list of links for the index
